metadata.description: GitHub Copilot plugins by Trask Stalnaker

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Review a GitHub pull request and create a verified pending review with high-confidence inline comments.

plugins.name: copilot-review-loop
plugins.description: Address Copilot pull request review comments, publish fixes, and repeat until the review is clean.

plugins.name: self-review-loop
plugins.description: Review a GitHub pull request, verify each finding independently, and commit the fixes without posting review comments.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Review and automatically update a pull request title and description with head verification.

plugins.name: pr-pipeline
plugins.description: Drive one pull request or a selected native-stack suffix through conflict resolution, review, CI fixing, and description validation.

plugins.name: conflict-fix-loop
plugins.description: Resolve merge conflicts on a pull request by keeping both sides' intent, then push and repeat until GitHub reports it mergeable.

plugins.name: ci-fix-loop
plugins.description: Fix the failing continuous integration checks a pull request caused, re-run a suspected flake once, and push the fixes until the checks are green.

plugins.name: historical-pr-audit
plugins.description: Audit an already-merged GitHub pull request against its own historical snapshot, verify each finding independently, and commit the fixes on a separate audit branch.
